name: Comms Edge
job: Inbound IVR +18663444955 and the two chat widgets. Short missed-call SMS, transactional, no quiet hours. NEVER creates a Sales opportunity.

trigger.notes: Transactional; no quiet hours. New contacts route to WF-01 (stamp next-lander) so WF-01 owns the Sales opp create-once.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: IVR +18663444955 or chat widget inbound
named_steps.comment: Sole entry for IVR + chat. Must not create a Sales opportunity here.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: Branch on channel (IVR missed-call | chat)
named_steps.comment: Splits IVR missed-call vs chat paths for tagging and copy.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_ivr (IVR branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 source tag for IVR.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_source_chat (chat branch)
named_steps.comment: New v2 source tag for chat widgets.

named_steps.name: SMS: Missed-call ack (inline, IVR branch, first in this sequence)
named_steps.comment: Short missed-call SMS. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Transactional; no quiet hours.

named_steps.name: EMAIL: Chat follow-up (native template, chat branch)
IF-ELSE: New contact vs existing contact
named_steps.comment: Existing contacts stay on their current opp. New contacts route to WF-01.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: next-lander (new contact only, so WF-01 enrolls)
named_steps.comment: Live tag next-lander is required by the WF-01 trigger. Do not rename next-lander.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: New contact re-enters WF-01 (create-once owner)
named_steps.comment: WF-01 owns the create-once Sales opp. Never create a Sales opp here.
